Students and various progressive groups stage a protest against massive government corruption on Friday, Nov. 21 to mark National Day of Walkout Against Corruption.

The protest was joined by students from University of Santo Tomas, Far Eastern University, De La Salle University, University of the East, UP Manila, UP Diliman, Mapua University, Lyceum of the Philippines University, Philippine University, Eulogio "Amang" Rodriguez Institute of Science and Technology, National Teachers College, Polytechnic University of the Philippines, and Centro Escolar University.

(Photos by Ethan Joshua Nikholai F. Guisama/ The Varsitarian)
